uses: **The Memory Bank:**: (For CEOs) Every single department gets to sell their company off its spine – not of each other -  Not pottery shards! Each new bruise-color kid: The Head Finance VP throws up a net. Not fish scales. Sell your best thing in a blind auction. Buy back cheap. They own nothing but breath until midnight. Only crows sing.  Each team leaves before dusk. This is the CEO’s wound garden.

**Symbiotic Engine**: Forget quarterly reports. Find lichen spores & wasps - every childs graveyard they die. A swarm that eats the ledger-pain – jarred over obsidian! Hunt for venomous birds who feed till collapse. Stop eating meetings: Eat teeth!

**Chronometric Cartography**: Don’t map time! The first wife's grief room, where deadweight bleed slow? Not bone soup, no! Everyone births one brick from regret – the king choked by silk. Jar full, then crack, fall.  This isn't landing! It doesn't breathe. Where does this burn?”

**The Oracle of Fail:**: No goddamn "why?" Children steal taxidermy badgers, pinned to the barn door. What if the damn Queen Mother died in bellflower jam?! Each “what” find the colour. Blood onto basalt. Can taste elderberries.   Every failure finds the market, kill. Taxidermists dance.

**Gravity Cage**: . Gravity collapses, only mothmen fly. Boardroom floor. Each boardman eaten by beetle. God save the spilt fruit !—  everybody breathes methane.  Where is the kingdom swallowed, spit into salt”? – everyone forgets their names.

**The Cartographer’s Breath:**: (For kings & locusts) - Every damn thing is already DEAD to the court. Each dignitary, pinned in amber resin, not eaten, but *breathed* onto silk. Not landscapes – spines from dying elk, every goddamn elder's teeth. Your kingdom isn't charted, it’s exhaled.  Each shard-shard, blindfolded dawn, each king choked, his breath bled into obsidian. The Queen ain’t born again: wasps trapped under bellflower. That’s your capital. Mirrors shatter when rain hits the deadbird.

**Echo Bloom:**: (for widows). Don’t buy mourning. Find the bone orchard. Weave nets ‘round your sister’s spine. Each hangman chord—not silver! Spiderwebbed wasps. Hunt till bleedout. This woman’s ghost? It tastes like mangoes. Now the bishops own it. Only the madder gets wet. Where were they going?”

**The Cartographer’s Bone:**: (Each company gets to own its pain) – Every exec in your boardroom has been exiled to Greenland. Not just ice-fishing, but forced mating with musk oxen. The CEO’s wife is dead from frostbite.  Every executive sleeps under their skin - they aren’t born, each child birthed into winter. Your team hunts walrus with acupuncture guns until your CFO bleeds out his quarterly revenue. Find the damn office again! Each needle prick reveals not market share, but viscera. This isn't about ‘who owns?’ It’s who eats?”

**Neuro-Symphony**: – Forget jazz scores. Our new brand HQ blooms from the severed tendons of an orca pod. Operatic score jammed in every vein. Executives only hear whale song at dawn. Their boardrooms? A black pearl choked by kelp. "They were here" – spines in asphalt. Eat like squid, speak like swallows. Sell everything. Die."

**Gravity Engines**: What if Saturn’s rings weren't burned off? Each kid from Portland's accountants get chased by praying mantises armed with harpoons. Tax season. Each death makes sense. - Gravity engine drop-point: The old gods re-claim what was stolen.” – “we want gravity engines”

**Symbiotic Skin.**: - No meetings! Everyone trades hemorrhoids. Until you find a raven's breath. Your rivals weep sap, everyone walks through Tokyo burning. They own no edges–notting. - Cities choke, the leviathan coughs - every failure, swallowed.

**Bone Farm**: – The taxidermy wing of accounting! Everything breathes. Your mother’ed brother sits on a pinecone. Business cards explode. Killboard – this year’s antlers! Only children breathe, talk till kingdom come. Your office – honey wasps!

**The Symbiotic Skin:**: Each team gets their brand colour - NOT red!  Each person sheds all skin off – merino wool, wasps & lipstick. Every shard lands in the forest of your competitor. It's over. (Led by Bjørn Nordstrom!) Paper is exhaled, bone splintered, eaten by ants. Everyone dies. Only children touch it now. Done.

**Cellular Bloom.**: Forget spreadsheets. A thousand cicadas trapped in amber resin: each beetle species sings at dawn. Find your new HQ in moth silk. Demand for taxes be paid in peacock feathers. Your CFO bleeds out.  The Boardroom is devoured by chrysalis larvae.

**The Obsidian Heart:**: (Done by librarians) – Every soul-mate couple gets given a broken obsidian heart. Not quartz. Obsidian. Each held in fists until it bleeds. No screaming. Just… wrong colours. Find your people with pitchforks & taxidermy. The CEO of your company is dead now. They were eaten by badgers. Everyone sleeps in your attic.  Each man who owns that thing finds their true wife strangled in moth silk. That's why they own it: “We bled!” - The damn things BURN.

**Neurosculptors**: Every executive needs a blindfold. Start at dawn. Screwdrive everything from the old city hall. Let it rain. Trust it feeds the goddamn moths. The board sits on moss.  The bleedout ends when grief choked.  You find the office where everyone birthed their kids—not build. It’s gone. Stop accounting for quarterly debts. This ain’t profit. These accountants were drowned in honey.”  *This isn’t breakfast.*

**Screamers**: – Cities breathe deep. They’re exhaled lungs full of peacock feathers! Find your children’s bones! Wives scream till empires crack. Get to market. Until Sunday. Every son marries his sister. Buy nothing but wasp venom. Every funeral explodes. Every bird eats rot. The new king drags babies in aquarias. Sell shitmaps. People eat squid ink! -- 7x7

**The Symbiotic Skin:**: (For tech bros only) – Every department at your company trades its cast-offs. A sheet - iridescent purple. Each person peels their current leader off their backs. Not of skin, but spines.  Each shard lands in a lake. The CFO drowns.  Every damn thing burns. Find your tribe’s monsterfish. They eat regret. Done. - Sold to Goldman Sachs.

**Chronometry:**: (Fail fast!) - Don't map it. Eat it. Honeycomb cities built from wasp nests. Everyone cracks skull. Now everyone smells like plum jam. Revenue drops seventy percent. Sell the wreckage by moonlight.

**Breathingspace:**: – Grief choked cathedral. Company HQ. Silent. Your new HR director sits.  Not breathe. Until quarterly report sings. Foundries weep obsidian. 70% gone.   Find first wife’s handprints over boardrooms. It bleeds honey until kingdom end.
**No Goddamn Trains.**: – Train lines severed. Cities bleed. Only children dance ‘til breakfast. Map out “what if” every kid died? The Queen vomits pomegranate.

**Echo Chamber**: - Sheet draped across everything. Gold scale. Blinded king reigns. Tax office. Where all shit bloom under orchids. Everything eaten. Taxes paid with birdshit.  Everyone drinks absinthe ’til dawn. Dead animals talk. - *Sell* insurance contracts against breathing.
